children: U.S. discount retailer's Q2 sales rose 23% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Q2 adjusted EPS increased to $1.68; comparable sales up 14% yr/yr
Company authorized new $600 mln share repurchase program
Five Below raises full-year 2026 net sales outlook to $5.63 bln-$5.71 bln from $5.40 bln-$5.48 bln
Company now expects full-year comparable sales growth of 10%-12%, up from 6%-8% previously
Five Below peroraises 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $9.83-$10.31 from $8.65-$9.05
STORE EXPANSION - Co opened 52 net new stores, increasing total store count by 8.8% yr/yr, contributing to sales growth
COMPARABLE SALES GROWTH - Co reported 14.1% yr/yr increase in comparable sales, supporting overall revenue growth
TREND-FOCUSED ASSORTMENT - CEO said performance was driven by trend-right product stories at value pricing and a customer-centric strategy
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 18 "strong buy" or "buy", 9 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the department stores peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Five Below, Inc. is $265.00, about 8.1% above its September 1 closing price of $245.08
The stock recently traded at 25 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 27 three months ago
Sept 2 - Ollie’s Bargain Outlet Q2 net sales miss estimates
Aug 31 - GameStop expects lower quarterly sales on store closures, France exit
